Nvidia stock drops nearly 5 percent after CEO Jensen Huang resigns over an affair with a Singapore-based executive alleged to have Chinese intelligence links. CFO Colette Kress becomes interim chief, as US lawmakers raise national security concerns. 

Al Jazeera’s Kristen Saloomey reports.

At least six Palestinians, including a surgeon and a 13-year-old boy, were killed in an Israeli strike on Gaza’s Nasser Medical Complex. Dozens more were injured. It is the seventh attack on the facility since October 2023.

Incoming Democratic majorities plan investigations into Nvidia’s $25m donation to Donald Trump’s White House ballroom, amid questions over favourable treatment and reported spy-linked warnings about its CEO that the White House denies. 

Al Jazeera’s Patty Culhane reports.
